create.name: Matthew Brensilver
create.bio:
Matthew Brensilver teaches insight meditation in the Theravada tradition, mostly through silent retreats on the US West Coast and online. He came to the dharma through teachers such as Gil Fronsdal, Shinzen Young, Ajahn Sucitto and Michele McDonald, and for over ten years he was one of the core teachers at Against the Stream in Los Angeles. Before teaching full time he trained and worked as a social worker and earned a doctorate in social work at USC, then spent years in university research and lecturing at UCLA's mindfulness centre, where he explored how meditation, science and psychology meet. He later directed programmes for Mindful Schools.

Today he leads retreats at the Insight Retreat Center in Santa Cruz, at Spirit Rock and at IMS in Barre, and offers a regular evening group for Insight Meditation Center that is streamed on YouTube. His talks are frank, warm and often funny, and keep returning to how mindfulness ripens into love and how wisdom and kindness depend on each other. With Oren Jay Sofer and JoAnna Hardy he co-wrote two books on bringing mindfulness to teenagers, and he sits on the boards of Spirit Rock and Insight Meditation Center.

books.title: Teaching Mindfulness to Empower Adolescents
books.author: Matthew Brensilver, JoAnna Hardy, Oren Jay Sofer
books.description: A guide for teachers, youth workers and parents on sharing mindfulness with teenagers, from the authors' work with Mindful Schools. It covers how to hold a class, what adolescents need and how to keep one's own practice alive while teaching.

books.title: The Mindful Schools Curriculum and Teacher's Guide
books.author: Matthew Brensilver, JoAnna Hardy, Oren Jay Sofer
books.description: A boxed curriculum of lesson plans for teaching mindfulness to secondary-school students, written as a companion to the authors' guide for educators.

courses.title: Moving Towards Freedom with Love and Wisdom Livestream Retreat 2027
courses.description: A four-night IMS Online retreat streamed from the IMS meditation hall, taught with Roxanne Dault. Silent sitting and walking periods alternate with live instructions and evening talks, followed at home on a suggested schedule.

courses.title: Insight Retreat with Gil Fronsdal and Matthew Brensilver
courses.description: A week of silent mindfulness practice at the Insight Retreat Center near Santa Cruz, co-taught with Gil Fronsdal. Places are given by lottery and the retreat is open to beginners and experienced meditators.

courses.title: The Convergence of Wisdom and Love
courses.description: A five-day silent retreat in the mountains at Big Bear Retreat Center in southern California. Sitting, walking, eating and resting are all treated as practice, with instructions, group discussions and talks on how mindfulness opens into kindness.
courses.price: From $510 USD (triple room, meals and lodging included)

courses.title: Insight Retreat with Matthew Brensilver (October 2027)
courses.description: A seven-night silent insight retreat at the Insight Retreat Center, with a co-teacher still to be named. Registration opens in June 2027 and places are allocated by lottery.
